title: The v2 shell
summary: v2's background, fonts and motion settings with a tuning panel over real posters; the top menu replacing the sidebar; Home in v2's look. Re-skins the existing browse screen.

brief.direction: Re-skin the existing browse screen into v2 — tokens, background, fonts, top menu, poster sizes, hero — keeping its data, row model, art cache, deck and Kids; put the motion lab's toggles in a hidden panel so tuning happens on real art.

rejected.option: A new v2 home screen beside the old one
rejected.why: a second rail pool, masthead and key routing — throwaway, since v2 ends as one app
rail geometry is constants; a switch means making them runtime values for a look nobody will go back to

decided: it needs built in to the app as I need posters to come up and hero images to show
gradient shift I like but the gradient is very liney on the tv
an option to go into the servers ... access the categories they have there
build this on a separate feature branch
agree with quick fix and investigate later

points.q: Timing presets should retune the existing --t-quick/--t-move/--t-fade and reuse .no-anim, not add parallel tokens nothing reads.
points.if: 061 steps 1,3 and the smoke step change
points.answer: Spec bug, fixed in 061 by the orchestrator.

points.q: Servers should be the per-server browser in v2-decisions, not the old sidebar renamed (which also holds Search, Devices, Autoplay, Theme music).
points.if: 062 labels the sidebar 'More'; a separate task builds Servers
points.answer: Stuart, 2026-11-16: 'agree with quick fix and investigate later' — 062 labels the sidebar 'More'; the Servers browser is task 064.

points.q: Does Stuart's B8 remote have colour buttons? The Magic Remote has none (browse.ts:234, graph), so Blue may not open the panel.
points.if: move the panel toggle to a key the remote has
points.answer: Stuart, 2026-11-16: 'it has colour buttons' — Blue opens the panel.

points.q: Skip-on-repeat on by default when Stuart was unsure what it was.
points.if: ship off, or on with an explanation
points.answer: Explained to Stuart before the spec (held arrows jump instead of animating); on by default, toggle in the panel.
